turns.text: I called Wavora Lodge this morning. The side entrance is level, but a host has to unlock the quiet room.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good detail to share with guests. Make sure a host knows they're responsible for the room.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Also Yuvshen uses a folding cane now, which he didn't need two years ago, and he wants a seat near the doorway.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'll keep that in mind for the seating plan.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll ask Veylanu to host on 19 February so Veylanu can unlock the quiet room.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That should make the room easier for guests to use.
